instruction: Replace the fluorine atom with a chlorine atom.

Replace the aniline benzene ring (bearing the methyl and the fluorine) with a pyridine, placing the ring nitrogen at the carbon para to the methyl group, and keeping the methyl, the anilino linkage, and the fluorine in place.
Add a chlorine to the aniline ring at the open ring carbon that is ortho to the fluorine.

Replace the aniline benzene ring (bearing the methyl and the fluorine) with a 1,3-oxazole, attaching it to the anilino nitrogen through the oxazole 2-position and keeping both substituents: put the methyl at the 5-position and the fluorine at the 4-position.
Replace the 2,6-dichlorophenyl ring with a pyridine ring, keeping both chlorines: put the ring nitrogen at the carbon para to the bond joining this ring to the rest of the molecule.
